episode_summary: In this episode, Kim Rittberg shares strategies for enhancing social media engagement through personal content and video marketing. She emphasizes the importance of building connection and credibility with clients by sharing personal stories and client success. Kim also discusses the benefits of using both long and short form video content to establish market authority.
